rationale: AD-267 adds phase timings and work counters (report --timings). The ir component publishes the new module archkeel.ir.phases (Phase, WorkCounter, PhaseClock); analyzer and cli may use it; the enum-placement rule and the governance packages list name it; the check contract's run_report gains the keyword-only clock parameter. The calls_unresolved budget rises from 816 to 817 for one argparse call (report --timings) that the analyzer cannot resolve.
